annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1315 concerning the extension of the action taken by the Polish Office for Registration of Medicinal Products, Medical Devices and Biocidal Products permitting the making available on the market and use of the biocidal product Biobor JF
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1315 concerning the extension of the action taken by the Polish Office for Registration of Medicinal Products, Medical Devices and Biocidal Products permitting the making available on the market and use of the biocidal product Biobor JF
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 287/11
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission implementing decision allowing Poland to extend, until 6 November 2022, authorisation of the biocidal product Biobor JF for treating microbial contamination of aircraft fuel tanks under the Biocidal Products Regulation. It has no connection to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Poland may extend permission for Biobor JF use by professional users until 6 November 2022
Justified by air transport safety risks from fuel tank contamination
Addressed to the Polish Office for Registration of Medicinal Products, Medical Devices and Biocidal Products
